---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new module, crawler, or capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The idea**
What you'd like to be able to do.

**Shape**
- [ ] New shell module
- [ ] New OSINT source / crawler
- [ ] Investigation / AI improvement
- [ ] Other

**Why it's useful**
The problem it solves or the workflow it unlocks.

**Notes**
Any APIs, tools, or prior art worth referencing. For a new source, note whether it's a
thin API (native crawler) or a heavy vendored tool (sibling container).
